synthesize.question: Summarize PepsiCo's seven reportable segments named in the filing.
synthesize.golden_answer: FLNA, QFNA, PBNA, LatAm, Europe, AMESA, APAC

synthesize.question: List the main routes to market PepsiCo says it uses to distribute products.
synthesize.golden_answer: DSD, customer warehouse, distributor networks, e-commerce

synthesize.question: Name the three key pillars of PepsiCo Positive (pep+).
synthesize.golden_answer: Positive Agriculture, Positive Value Chain, Positive Choices

synthesize.question: Summarize the major categories of PepsiCo's 2021 acquisition and divestiture-related charges by transaction type.
synthesize.golden_answer: inventory fair value, merger and integration charges, divestiture costs

synthesize.question: List the major customer types PepsiCo identifies in the Business section.
synthesize.golden_answer: distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers, bottlers

synthesize.question: Summarize the main competitive factors PepsiCo says its products compete on.
synthesize.golden_answer: brand, taste, price, value, quality, variety, innovation, distribution, marketing, packaging, convenience, service

synthesize.question: List the principal ingredients PepsiCo says it uses in beverage and convenient food products.
synthesize.golden_answer: juice concentrates, aspartame, corn, sweeteners, flavorings, flour, fruits, oats, potatoes, milk, rice, seasonings, sucralose, sugar, oils, wheat, water

synthesize.question: Summarize the key packaging and commodity inputs PepsiCo highlights as important to its business.
synthesize.golden_answer: PET, polypropylene, aluminum, glass, closures, cardboard, paperboard, fuel, electricity, natural gas

synthesize.question: List the countries PepsiCo identifies as its largest operations in the Business section.
synthesize.golden_answer: United States, Mexico, Russia, Canada, China, United Kingdom, South Africa

synthesize.question: Summarize the key human capital priorities PepsiCo highlights.
synthesize.golden_answer: safety, health, diversity, equity and inclusion, talent attraction, retention, development, training

synthesize.question: List the companies PepsiCo explicitly names as key beverage or food competitors besides Coca-Cola.
synthesize.golden_answer: Campbell Soup, Conagra, Hormel, Kellogg, Keurig Dr Pepper, Kraft Heinz, Link Snacks, Mondelēz, Monster, Nestlé, Red Bull, Utz

synthesize.question: Summarize the main types of research and development activities PepsiCo describes.
synthesize.golden_answer: product innovation, process improvement, nutrition reformulation, sustainable packaging, dispensing equipment, SodaStream innovation, digital technology, e-commerce, environmental reduction

synthesize.question: List the categories of COVID-19-related charges PepsiCo identified by division in 2021.
synthesize.golden_answer: credit losses, upfront payments to customers, inventory write-downs and returns, employee compensation, employee protection costs, other

synthesize.question: Summarize the principal sources of liquidity PepsiCo identifies.
synthesize.golden_answer: cash from operations, Juice Transaction proceeds, commercial paper, long-term debt, cash and cash equivalents

synthesize.question: List the major current liabilities PepsiCo reports on its 2021 balance sheet detail.
synthesize.golden_answer: accounts payable, accrued marketplace spending, accrued compensation and benefits, dividends payable, current lease liabilities, other current liabilities

synthesize.question: Summarize the main forms of share-based compensation PepsiCo uses.
synthesize.golden_answer: stock options, RSUs, PSUs, long-term cash awards

synthesize.question: List the key 2021 debt issuances PepsiCo completed by maturity.
Summarize PepsiCo's principal executive corporate properties named in Item 2.
synthesize.golden_answer: principal executive office in Purchase, New York and facilities in Plano, Texas

synthesize.question: List the shared service center locations PepsiCo identifies in Item 2.
synthesize.golden_answer: Winston Salem, North Carolina; Hyderabad, India

synthesize.question: Summarize what free cash flow means for PepsiCo in this filing.
synthesize.golden_answer: net cash from operating activities less capital spending plus sales of property, plant and equipment
